name: Install LLVM and Clang
description: Downloads and installs LLVM and Clang binaries.

version.description: The version of LLVM and Clang binaries to install.

arch.description: The archtecture (either `x64` or `arm64`) to install LLVM and Clang binaries for.

force-url.description: The full download URL to use for LLVM and Clang binaries.

directory.description: The directory to install LLVM and Clang binaries to.

cached.description: Whether the LLVM and Clang binaries were cached.

mirror-url.description: The base URL to download LLVM and Clang binaries from instead of using GitHub.

auth.description: The Authorization header to use when downloading LLVM and Clang binaries.

env.description: Whether to set CC and CXX environment variables to Clang paths.
